risk_summary: Fiscal 2024 performance deteriorated materially, with comparable sales down 10.6%, sharply lower earnings, margin pressure from occupancy deleverage, and expectations of continued sales weakness into early fiscal 2025. Liquidity remains a mitigating factor, including $48.4 million of cash and investments, no credit-facility borrowings, and $64.7 million of availability, although free cash flow was only $1.9 million after capital expenditures.
